notes.title: Update b0.25
notes.content:
The last update of the year is out! 


 Finally managed to take out the Steam overlay bug (hopefully). Thank you for helping us track it down.
 New palettes, finally! In the editor, the palette popup now has a header where you can select a different palette for your image.
 As usual, we also made a few tiny tweaks and bug fixes.

Happy new year everyone!

💖 Eduardo & Isabel

notes.title: Update b0.24
notes.content:
We've released a new update!


the newly introduced mistake warnings can now be disabled in the settings (per puzzle type) 
tweaked starting scale of Plus puzzles
tutorial tweaks and fixes
fixed several minor bugs/glitches

Please keep reporting any issues you find and we'll keep fixing them!

Thank you for your support!

💖 Eduardo & Isabel

notes.title: Update b0.23b
notes.content: Tiny patch to fix bugs we introduced with yesterday's update. >_>

notes.title: Update b0.23
notes.content:
A new update is out!


added Spanish localization
replaced the existing soundtrack with new lofi music by the lovely  Purrple Cat (more tracks coming soon!)
the UI now warns you of obvious mistakes in both Plus and Squared (ex. filling 6 squares around a 5)
puzzles with a custom background color now display said color
the "Find incomplete" button actually works again
fixed a few annoying issues in the editor 
prepared the client to support multiple color palettes (new palettes coming soon!)

If you find any issues please let us know and we'll do our best to get them fixed!

Thank you for your support!

💖 Eduardo & Isabel

notes.title: Update b0.22
notes.content:
We've released a new update!


 Undo and redo! (the shortcuts are Ctrl + Z and Ctrl + Y)
 New option in Plus to automatically cross empty squares when you "complete" a line. Please keep in mind this will trigger whenever you fill the correct amount of squares, it does not guarantee those squares are in the correct place.
 New shortcut (F) to find unsolved numbers in Squared and Links (particularly useful for extra large puzzles).
 The usual amount of tiny tweaks and bug fixes.

Please keep an eye out for any new bugs - we'll try to have them quickly fixed!

💖 Eduardo & Isabel

notes.title: Micro patch b0.21a
notes.content:
This tiny update fixes an annoying editor bug that a few reported.

If you find any issues please let us know and we'll do our best to get them fixed!

💖 Eduardo & Isabel

notes.title: Update b0.21
notes.content:
We've released a new update!


finishing a puzzle while filters are active no longer sends you to the first page of the results
solved puzzles should no longer disappear sometimes from the puzzle list until you restart the game
Plus: drawing a line very quickly no longer skips any squares
Squared: lowered opacity of non-selected color to improve readability (tried a few other things but they were a bust)
board interaction helpers are now hidden while in pan mode
fixed a few minor bugs/glitches

💖 Eduardo & Isabel

notes.title: Micro patch b0.20a
notes.content: This patch fixes the broken Tutorials that we managed to break with the previous update. >_>

notes.title: Update b0.20
notes.content:
A new update is out!

 
fixed stuck input issue (hopefully)
fixed filters not showing any XL puzzles
timers can now be hidden (in Settings > Global)
scrollwheel can now be used to cycle through colors (toggle in Settings > Controls)
WASD directions can now be inverted (in Settings > Controls)
custom colors on a puzzle are now saved between sessions
added more music tracks

We're now working on the remaining reported issues and requested features!

💖 Eduardo & Isabel

notes.title: Update b0.19e
notes.content:
Tiny patch fixing a couple of issues:


 made rate bonus more obvious - you receive Coins even if there are no images to review
 creating a Picma account from the Profile page now updates the UI properly

We're working on several other reported issues and will update again as soon as possible!

notes.title: Our first Steam update is out! (b.19d)
notes.content:
improved game initialization process - it should now retry reaching the server many more times before giving up
 changed wording of the account linking screen - it should now be clear that you only need a Steam account to play
 fullscreen is now enabled by default
 music is now enabled by default (sound sfx coming soon)
 removed repeated Terms & Conditions popup
 fixed Links puzzles not restarting properly
 fixed a few minor bugs

Please keep reporting any issues you find and we'll keep fixing them!

Thank you for your support!

💖 Eduardo & Isabel
